description: Fields from competitors/findings.jsonl that the contract has no place for, keyed by contract record_id / claim_id. Not read by the team validator or exporter.

luis:us_mercedes-F0001.statement: Owner of a 2025 E 350 rates the build quality as excellent.

luis:us_mercedes-F0002.statement: Owner states the four-cylinder E 350 has sufficient power and runs at only about 1,300 rpm at 65 mph.

luis:us_mercedes-F0003.statement: Owner states the cabin is quiet at highway speed.

luis:us_mercedes-F0004.statement: Owner reports about 42 mpg on the highway with two people aboard and cruise control set at 65 mph.

luis:us_mercedes-F0005.statement: Owner states the air vents give very good airflow without blowing directly on the occupants.

luis:us_mercedes-F0006.statement: Owner finds the voice command system helpful.

luis:us_mercedes-F0007.statement: Owner states the voice assistant sometimes activates unexpectedly.

luis:us_mercedes-F0008.statement: Owner states rear foot room is too tight, making a one-hour trip in the back uncomfortable; a 2024 Toyota Camry's rear seat felt more comfortable.

luis:us_mercedes-F0009.statement: Owner finds getting in and out of the car difficult, even after adjusting the seat.

luis:us_mercedes-F0010.statement: Owner misses a front seat thigh extension for tall drivers and passengers.

luis:us_mercedes-F0011.statement: Owner reports the adaptive cruise control braked hard without warning on the highway, dropping from 65 to 35 mph, most often near exits.

luis:us_mercedes-F0012.statement: Owner states lane departure warning gives only a faint steering-wheel vibration and does not steer the car back, unlike the family's Toyota, Hyundai and VW cars.

luis:us_mercedes-F0013.statement: Owner complains there is no spare tire; with run-flat tires, a flat after hours or on a weekend meant waiting about two days for a replacement.

luis:us_mercedes-F0014.statement: Owner states the touch-sensitive steering-wheel controls change the instrument cluster display too easily.

luis:us_mercedes-F0015.statement: Owner reports the right windshield wiper makes a loud noise in light rain, and a friend's car has the same issue.

luis:us_mercedes-F0016.statement: Owner finds the standard speakers adequate, although louder audio would need the roughly $1,000 Burmester 4D option.

luis:us_mercedes-F0017.statement: Owner questions spending about $72,000 on the car and says they would not make the same purchase again.

luis:us_premium_others-F0044.vfc_level2: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology
luis:us_premium_others-F0044.statement: Owner of a 2021 G80 3.5T AWD Prestige states the car is a pleasure to drive.

luis:us_premium_others-F0045.statement: Owner praises the value of the car.

luis:us_premium_others-F0046.statement: Owner states the dealerships sell a luxury car in a not-so-luxurious environment.

luis:us_premium_others-F0047.statement: Owner of a first-year new-design G80 criticizes the four-cylinder engine and its vibration.

luis:us_premium_others-F0048.statement: Owner states fuel economy is worse than with the previous model's 3.8-liter engine.

luis:us_premium_others-F0049.statement: Owner criticizes cheap plastic parts and poor build quality.

luis:us_premium_others-F0050.statement: Owner states the automatic emergency braking does not work.

luis:us_premium_others-F0051.statement: Owner states the lane control behaves erratically.

luis:us_premium_others-F0052.statement: Owner reports dealer service problems, states the manufacturer refused repairs and mentions the lemon law.

luis:us_premium_others-F0053.statement: Owner states the G80 looks great while calling the rest of the car a step backwards.

luis:us_premium_others-F0054.statement: Owner states the driver-attention 'consider taking a break' alert fires randomly every 5 to 30 minutes with a loud beep and cannot be turned off; they call it a deal breaker.

luis:us_premium_others-F0055.statement: Owner of a G80 2.5 Prestige RWD, previously a Lexus ES owner, praises the power.

luis:us_premium_others-F0057.statement: Owner praises how quiet the car is.

luis:us_premium_others-F0058.statement: Owner states the car stays comfortable on 9-hour drives and praises the massaging seats.

luis:us_premium_others-F0061.vfc_level2: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology
luis:us_premium_others-F0061.statement: Owner of a 2024 G80 3.5T Sport Prestige (their third G80) praises the ride, handling and braking.

luis:us_premium_others-F0065.statement: Owner praises the value of the car.

luis:us_premium_others-F0066.statement: Owner states the 2024 model dropped the rear window shades and soft-close doors of the 2021 and would give up the rear-wheel steering to get them back.

luis:us_premium_others-F0067.statement: Owner praises the car's attractive looks.

luis:us_premium_others-F0068.statement: Owner dislikes the two-spoke steering wheel.

luis:us_premium_others-F0069.statement: Owner wants a fully digital gauge cluster included with the Advanced package.

luis:us_premium_others-F0071.statement: Owner praises the ride and handling.

luis:us_premium_others-F0073.statement: Owner notes a brief delay when accelerating hard.

luis:us_premium_others-F0074.statement: Owner of a new 2022 G80 complains that the car has no wireless phone charging pad.

luis:us_premium_others-F0075.statement: Owner, who previously owned a BMW 5 Series (earlier generation, not G60), states the G80's back seat is spacious unlike the 5 Series'.

luis:us_premium_others-F0076.statement: Owner praises the smooth ride and handling.

luis:us_premium_others-F0078.statement: Owner reports no mechanical issues in the first three months.

luis:us_premium_others-F0079.statement: Owner praises the value of the car.

luis:us_premium_others-F0080.statement: Owner wants Genesis to develop its own dealer network.
luis:us_premium_others-F0080.quote: Genesis needs to develop its own dealer network

luis:us_premium_others-F0109.statement: Owner of a 2021 ES 300h hybrid praises the safety features.

luis:us_premium_others-F0110.statement: Owner reports a consistent 43-44 mpg from the hybrid.

luis:us_premium_others-F0111.statement: Owner finds the large screen easy to read and says the touchpad is easy to get used to, dismissing negative touchpad reviews.

luis:us_premium_others-F0112.statement: Owner finds the seats firmer than they would like.

luis:us_premium_others-F0113.statement: Owner of a 2020 ES 350 reports excessive wind and road noise, especially a rushing noise from the rear side window, that the dealer failed to fix in two attempts.

luis:us_premium_others-F0114.statement: Owner states the dealer said acoustic windows would help but they are only fitted to the Luxury trim, which was not disclosed in writing.

luis:us_premium_others-F0115.statement: Owner praises the strong engine response of the V6.

luis:us_premium_others-F0116.statement: Senior owner calls the car easy to drive and reliable, the best and last car they will own.

luis:us_premium_others-F0117.statement: Owner reports five years of ownership with no problems.

luis:us_premium_others-F0118.statement: Owner praises the smooth, relaxing ride on short and long trips.

luis:us_premium_others-F0119.statement: Owner of a 2019 ES 350 tells shoppers looking at the 5-Series (also E-Class, G80) that the ES is the best choice, citing price and reliability.

luis:us_premium_others-F0120.statement: Owner praises the luxury features such as heated and cooled seats, moonroof and power trunk lid at an affordable price.

luis:us_premium_others-F0123.vfc_level2: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology
luis:us_premium_others-F0123.statement: Owner concedes the ES is less performance-oriented than its European competitors.

luis:us_premium_others-F0124.vfc_level2: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology
luis:us_premium_others-F0124.statement: Owner of a 2024 ES F Sport praises the safety technology.

luis:us_premium_others-F0126.statement: Owner praises the F Sport styling.

luis:us_premium_others-F0127.statement: Owner of a 2024 ES 250 AWD Luxury praises the build quality and materials.

luis:us_premium_others-F0128.statement: Owner values all-wheel drive for snow, noting the ES 350 is not offered with AWD.

luis:us_premium_others-F0129.statement: Owner praises the quiet cabin and highway comfort.

luis:us_premium_others-F0130.statement: Owner wants heated or ventilated rear seats and rear climate controls, which the car lacks.

luis:us_premium_others-F0131.statement: Owner regrets the removal of the CD player.

luis:us_premium_others-F0132.statement: Owner states the infotainment system needs updating.

luis:us_premium_others-F0133.statement: Owner reports problems with the wireless phone charger.

luis:us_premium_others-F0134.statement: Owner states the front parking sensors beep constantly when covered with snow.

luis:us_premium_others-F0135.statement: Owner finds the fuel economy of about 22-26 mpg modest for a four-cylinder.

luis:us_premium_others-F0136.statement: Owner dislikes having to pay extra for the better stereo.

luis:us_premium_others-F0137.statement: Owner of a 2025 ES 300h praises the comfort and serenity on the highway.

luis:us_premium_others-F0138.statement: Owner praises the smooth hybrid drivetrain.

luis:us_premium_others-F0139.statement: Owner praises the fuel economy and low running costs.

luis:us_premium_others-F0140.statement: Owner notes the rear seats do not fold down.

luis:us_premium_others-F0273.statement: Owner of a CT5 Premium Luxury 2.0T (bought Aug 2022) praises the comfortable seats.

luis:us_premium_others-F0275.statement: Owner likes the fold-down rear seats.

luis:us_premium_others-F0276.statement: Owner likes the wood and leather trim.

luis:us_premium_others-F0280.statement: Owner reports no issues in the first nine months and likes the dealer's pickup and return service.

luis:us_premium_others-F0281.statement: Owner notes the trunk is smaller (than their previous CTS).

luis:us_premium_others-F0282.statement: Owner finds the suspension soft and wishes it had more adjustment.

luis:us_premium_others-F0283.statement: Owner wants massage seats, which are not offered with the four-cylinder.

luis:us_premium_others-F0284.statement: Owner wanted a paint color and the Sedona leather that could not be ordered for their configuration.

luis:us_premium_others-F0285.statement: Owner of an AWD CT5 Luxury with 21,000 miles reports up to 36 mpg.

luis:us_premium_others-F0286.statement: Owner finds the car has more power than expected.

luis:us_premium_others-F0287.statement: Owner praises the nice ride and good handling.

luis:us_premium_others-F0288.statement: Owner of a 2020 CT5 Sport 2.0T praises the engine power and the performance shift mode.

luis:us_premium_others-F0289.statement: Owner likes the lumbar massage, extendable seat cushion and driver footrest.

luis:us_premium_others-F0290.statement: Owner likes the Bose audio system.

luis:us_premium_others-F0291.statement: Owner likes the snow mode with AWD and the handling in sport mode.

luis:us_premium_others-F0293.statement: Owner of a CT5-V with the Platinum package praises the engine performance.

luis:us_premium_others-F0295.statement: Owner praises the luxury of the Platinum package.

luis:us_premium_others-F0296.statement: Owner of a CT5 Premium Luxury V6 finds visibility poor, solved by adding the camera package.

luis:us_premium_others-F0297.statement: Owner's car has no sunroof and they list that as a dislike.

luis:us_premium_others-F0299.statement: Owner likes the Bose sound system.

luis:us_premium_others-F0301.vfc_level2: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology
luis:us_premium_others-F0301.statement: Owner praises the ride and driving feel.

luis:us_premium_others-F0303.statement: Owner of a CT5 Premium Luxury 3.0 V6 praises the power.

luis:us_premium_others-F0304.statement: Owner praises the ride and handling in traffic.

luis:us_tesla_audi-F0159.statement: Owner complains that negative camber, which cannot be adjusted, wears the tires.

luis:us_tesla_audi-F0161.statement: Owner notes power is limited in winter.
